schema.name: index_metadata
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE index_metadata(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,store_id TEXT NOT NULL,index_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(index_mode IN ('text-only','vector-configured')),profile_json TEXT,profile_hash TEXT,CHECK((index_mode='text-only' AND profile_json IS NULL AND profile_hash IS NULL) OR (index_mode='vector-configured' AND profile_json IS NOT NULL AND profile_hash IS NOT NULL)))

schema.name: file_records
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE file_records(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,root_id TEXT,name TEXT NOT NULL,path TEXT,embedding_set_id TEXT,source_path TEXT,scoped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(scoped IN (0,1)),content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(root_id,id),CHECK((root_id IS NULL AND path IS NULL AND embedding_set_id IS NOT NULL AND scoped=1) OR (root_id IS NOT NULL AND path IS NOT NULL)))

schema.name: file_chunks
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE file_chunks(pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,root_id TEXT,file_record_id TEXT NOT NULL,start_line INTEGER NOT NULL,end_line INTEGER NOT NULL,content TEXT NOT NULL,content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,embedding_hash TEXT,chunk_index INTEGER,chunk_size INTEGER,chunk_type TEXT,start_offset INTEGER,end_offset INTEGER,token_count INTEGER,has_vector INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(has_vector IN (0,1)),CHECK(has_vector=0 OR embedding_hash IS NOT NULL),CHECK((chunk_index IS NULL AND chunk_size IS NULL AND chunk_type IS NULL AND start_offset IS NULL AND end_offset IS NULL AND token_count IS NULL) OR (chunk_index IS NOT NULL AND chunk_size IS NOT NULL AND chunk_type IS NOT NULL AND start_offset IS NOT NULL AND end_offset IS NOT NULL AND token_count IS NOT NULL AND chunk_index>=0 AND chunk_size>0 AND chunk_type IN ('text','sentence','recursive') AND start_offset>=0 AND end_offset>start_offset AND token_count>0)),FOREIGN KEY(file_record_id) REFERENCES file_records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

schema.name: chunks_file
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX chunks_file ON file_chunks(root_id,file_record_id)

schema.name: chunks_file_record
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX chunks_file_record ON file_chunks(file_record_id)

schema.name: file_symbols
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE file_symbols(file_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES file_records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,seq INTEGER NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('function','class','method','variable','interface','type','enum')),exported INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(exported IN (0,1)),start_line INTEGER NOT NULL,end_line INTEGER NOT NULL,start_offset INTEGER NOT NULL,end_offset INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(file_record_id,seq)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: idx_file_symbols_name
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_file_symbols_name ON file_symbols(name)

schema.name: file_symbol_refs
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE file_symbol_refs(file_record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES file_records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,seq INTEGER NOT NULL,from_symbol_seq INTEGER,name TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('call','import','extends','implements')),module TEXT,line INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(file_record_id,seq),FOREIGN KEY(file_record_id,from_symbol_seq) REFERENCES file_symbols(file_record_id,seq) ON DELETE CASCADE) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: idx_file_symbol_refs_name_kind
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_file_symbol_refs_name_kind ON file_symbol_refs(name,kind)

schema.name: file_chunks_fts
schema.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE file_chunks_fts USING fts5(content,content='file_chunks',content_rowid='pk',tokenize='porter unicode61')

schema.name: file_chunks_trigram
schema.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE file_chunks_trigram USING fts5(content,content='file_chunks',content_rowid='pk',tokenize='trigram')

schema.name: vec_chunks
schema.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE vec_chunks USING vec0(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,root_id TEXT PARTITION KEY,bin BIT[384],+emb BLOB)

schema.name: chunks_insert
chunks_delete
chunks_update
index_scope_authority
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE index_scope_authority(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),epoch TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: files_collection
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX files_collection ON file_records(embedding_set_id,id)

schema.name: vector_profiles
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE vector_profiles(profile_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,profile_json TEXT NOT NULL,dimensions INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(dimensions>0))

schema.name: scoped_vectors
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE scoped_vectors(pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,chunk_pk INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES file_chunks(pk) ON DELETE CASCADE,profile_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vector_profiles(profile_hash),content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,dimensions INTEGER NOT NULL,emb BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(emb)='blob' AND vec_length(emb)=dimensions),UNIQUE(chunk_pk,profile_hash))

schema.name: state_index_source
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_index_source(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),root TEXT,projection_identity TEXT,resource_grants TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: state_event_rows
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_event_rows(pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(seq>0),payload TEXT NOT NULL,content TEXT,gap_reason TEXT,UNIQUE(thread_id,seq))

schema.name: state_event_blob_refs
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_event_blob_refs(event_pk INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES state_event_rows(pk) ON DELETE CASCADE,hash TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(event_pk,hash)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: state_blob_hash
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX state_blob_hash ON state_event_blob_refs(hash)

schema.name: state_thread_cursors
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_thread_cursors(thread_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(seq>=0)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: state_dropped_blob_refs
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_dropped_blob_refs(thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(thread_id,hash)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: state_events_fts
schema.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE state_events_fts USING fts5(content,content='state_event_rows',content_rowid='pk',tokenize='unicode61')

schema.name: state_event_insert
state_event_delete
state_event_update
state_message_generation
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_message_generation(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>=0),pending_cleanup INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(pending_cleanup IN (0,1)))

schema.name: state_message_profiles
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_message_profiles(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,json TEXT NOT NULL,dimensions INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(dimensions>0))

schema.name: state_message_vectors
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE state_message_vectors(
        pk INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,root_id TEXT NOT NULL,resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        message_id TEXT NOT NULL,seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(seq>0),segment_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(segment_ordinal>=0),
        profile_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES state_message_profiles(hash),source_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        dimensions INTEGER NOT NULL,emb BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(emb)=dimensions*4),
        UNIQUE(thread_id,message_id,segment_ordinal,profile_hash))

schema.name: state_message_scope
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX state_message_scope ON state_message_vectors(root_id,resource_id,thread_id,profile_hash)

schema.name: scope_vec_384
schema.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE scope_vec_384 USING vec0(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,profile_hash TEXT PARTITION KEY,bin BIT[384])
